opportunities.name: Pick a film for movie night from IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then email the invite
opportunities.description: In the IMDb tab, click the search box, type "{film}" and press Enter; open the matching title -> Note the IMDb rating, the runtime and the director -> Switch to the Rotten Tomatoes tab, click the search box, type "{film}" and press Enter; open the matching movie and note the Tomatometer score -> Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {friend}@example.com, click Subject and type "Movie night {day}: {film}" -> Click Body and type "Hi {friend}, {day} we watch {film} (<director>, <runtime>): IMDb <rating>, Tomatometer <score>." Do not click Send. Click Discard

opportunities.name: Audit a JavaScript dependency on npm and its GitHub repo before upgrading
opportunities.description: In the npm tab, click the search box, type {package} and press Enter; open the package {package} -> Note the latest version, the weekly downloads and the license -> Click the Repository link on the right; the GitHub repo opens. Note the star count and the number of open issues -> Click Releases on the repo page and note the date of the latest release, then close that GitHub page if it opened in a new tab (otherwise click Back to return to npm) -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{package}: v<version>, <downloads>/week, <license>, <stars> stars, <issues> open issues, last release <date>" and press Enter

opportunities.name: Build a dinner menu item from Allrecipes and the dish's background on Wikipedia
opportunities.description: In the Allrecipes tab, click the search box, type "{dish}" and press Enter -> Open the first recipe with a rating; note its name, star rating and total time -> Scroll to the ingredients, set the servings to {servings} if the page allows it, and note the first three ingredients -> Switch to the Wikipedia tab, search "{dish}" and open the article; note the country of origin -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{dish} for {servings}: <recipe> (<stars> stars, <time>), needs <ingredients>. Origin: <country>" and press Enter
